property_summary: After one call to getFirstWithdrawalBonus by an eligible user, the correct contract sends 100 wei to the user and sets claimedBonus[user] to true; the buggy contract sets claimedBonus[user] to true but does not send the bonus, so the user's balance is 0 in the bug but 100 in the reference.
